{"test_name":"LedgerIssue2297Tests","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class LedgerIssue2297Tests\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedTypesAreDecoratedWithExcludeFromCodeCoverage()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing System;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestProject\n{\n    public enum SampleEnum\n    {\n        First,\n        Second,\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class IntKeyedObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public SampleEnum Kind { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public class StringKeyedObject\n    {\n        public string Name { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [Union(0, typeof(UnionImplA))]\n    [Union(1, typeof(UnionImplB))]\n    public interface ISampleUnion\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionImplA : ISampleUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionImplB : ISampleUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string Text { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class GenericObject<T>\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public T Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class RootHolder\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public IntKeyedObject IntObj { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public StringKeyedObject StringObj { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(2)]\n        public ISampleUnion UnionObj { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(3)]\n        public GenericObject<int> GenericObj { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references = net80Refs.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        SyntaxTree inputTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest));\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { inputTree },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        List<SyntaxTree> generatedTrees = output.SyntaxTrees\n            .Where(t => !compilation.SyntaxTrees.Contains(t))\n            .ToList();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedTrees);\n\n        List<string> typesMissingAttribute = new List<string>();\n        int checkedTypeCount = 0;\n\n        foreach (SyntaxTree tree in generatedTrees)\n        {\n            SemanticModel semanticModel = output.GetSemanticModel(tree);\n            SyntaxNode root = await tree.GetRootAsync(CancellationToken.None);\n\n            foreach (TypeDeclarationSyntax typeDecl in root.DescendantNodes().OfType<TypeDeclarationSyntax>())\n            {\n                INamedTypeSymbol? typeSymbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(typeDecl);\n                if (typeSymbol is null)\n                {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                if (typeSymbol.ContainingType is not null)\n                {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                if (typeSymbol.TypeKind is not (TypeKind.Class or TypeKind.Struct))\n                {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                checkedTypeCount++;\n                bool hasExcludeAttribute = typeSymbol.GetAttributes().Any(attr =>\n                    SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(attr.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n\n                if (!hasExcludeAttribute)\n                {\n                    typesMissingAttribute.Add(typeSymbol.ToDisplayString());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Assert.True(checkedTypeCount > 0, \"Expected at least one generated class or struct.\");\n        Assert.Empty(typesMissingAttribute);\n    }\n}\n"}
